</sub>  Apply a defined formula to benchmark variance

For the five-run fixture comparison, AC8 requires a numeric standard deviation but does not say whether to use the population or sample formula, so two compliant implementations record different figures from identical runs. The newly added population-formula clause in AC15 resolves this only for real-PR comparative claims, leaving benchmark evidence non-reproducible; specify the formula here as well.
